allocation.excess: payment amount beyond remittance lines is posted to customer_advances
allocation.prepayments: receipts without remittance lines are advances (customer_advances)
allocation.refunds: negative amount_minor; refund_of names the refunded receipt
allocation.rule: booked invoice_refs of a receipt must equal the remittance advice lines of its document

duplicates.rule: same entity, currency, total_minor and identical line_items (incl. service periods) posted more than once

fx.advances: converted at the receipt's own rate_date; refunds relieve advances at the original receipt rate
fx.ar_relief: invoice historical rate; the payment that fully settles an invoice clears its remaining AR
fx.rate_definition: 1 unit of source_currency = rate units of target_currency (major units)

ledger.entry_grouping: rows with the same payment_id form one entry; otherwise same (invoice_id, timestamp); otherwise same (entity_id, timestamp)

matching.amount_semantics: claimed_amount_minor is a non-negative magnitude in the stated currency

amounts.duplicate_invoice: total_minor of the duplicate, invoice currency
amounts.fx_wrong_date_or_rate: |booked base amount - correctly converted base amount|, base currency
amounts.missing_or_partial_allocation: remittance amount not allocated to the invoice, payment currency
amounts.period_cutoff_error: base amount of the wrongly included posting, base currency

canonical_affected_ids.fx_wrong_date_or_rate: [invoice_id or payment_id of the mis-converted document]
canonical_affected_ids.period_cutoff_error: [invoice_id or payment_id of the document booked in the wrong period]

required_evidence.duplicate_invoice: both invoice_id + one posting row (accounts_receivable debit or revenue) of EACH of the two invoices
required_evidence.fx_wrong_date_or_rate: document id + its posting row (accounts_receivable or revenue for an invoice; bank for a payment) + fx id of the correct rate: fx:<local date of the document in company timezone>:<document currency>:<base>
required_evidence.missing_or_partial_allocation: invoice_id + payment_id + the payment's customer_advances row
required_evidence.period_cutoff_error: document id + its posting row (accounts_receivable or revenue for an invoice; bank for a payment)
required_evidence.rule: evidence_ids must contain at least one complete admissible set (extra ids are allowed)

period.ledger_timestamp_rule: posting timestamp equals the source document instant
period.membership: document instant in [start 00:00, end+1day 00:00) in company timezone
period.opening_balances: invoices issued before start and open at start are posted as opening_balance_equity at start 00:00

rounding.scope: each conversion separately, to integer minor units
